title: FsMount
description: Mount the owner's bucket of the console's shared-folder gateway (juicefs-shared-storage design: one JuiceFS volume behind a `juicefs gateway --multi-buckets`, a bucket per user). Sent on the live link only to a daemon whose hello has fs_s3_mount: after the welcome when the owner has a ready folder, and again when the folder or its key change (generation grows). Unreliable and never logged or stored: it carries the owner's S3 key, which allows that bucket only. The daemon mounts it over S3 with the client named in client.tool at its own data directory and answers with fs.status; a generation older than the one mounted is ignored.

bucket.description: The owner's bucket (u-<16 hex>), also the mount directory name.

generation.description: Grows when the owner's folder is provisioned again; a remount is due when it or the bucket differs from the mounted one.

endpoint.description: The gateway's S3 address (https://..., path-style requests).

region.description: Region to sign requests for; default us-east-1.

client.description: The S3 mount client to run (tool): the daemon picks the asset of its platform (linux-amd64, linux-arm64, darwin-arm64…), downloads it and checks sha256, unless that exact version is already present.
